comparison.objective: Fit keycaps into the correct keyboard layout, versus finish threaded inserts by tang fracture.
comparison.physical_skill: Identity/layout matching and repeated press-fit insertion rather than coaxial tool stabilization, striking, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly placed and seated keycaps; seating tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four fractures without insert displacement and four contained tangs.
comparison.reason: Press-fit assembly and layout recognition are materially different tested abilities.
